scope: Island Bridge — main Daugava northwest lower gallery. Original, individually controlled member of the complete Island Bridge system. Sheltered lower pedestrian gallery: actual floor, inner painted wall, thin roof lining, low open-sided parapet and tubular handrail. Its walkway elevation is independent of the upper roadway.
